plugins.name: autocache
plugins.description: Session continuity for coding agents. Hooks capture what you were doing, local JSON state persists it, the next session restores it. Free tier: sessions, breadcrumbs, checkpoints, self-state, reminders. No corpus, no retrieval, no telemetry.
